## Synthetic data

The country-level carbon estimates and wetland-class shares below are synthetic,
but their spatial pattern was designed to resemble the supplied reference.

```{r data}
country_data <- tribble(

  "IT", "Italy",             12.4, 42.7,  12.7, 41.5,   95, 21,  5,  3, 71
) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    inland = max(1, inland_base + rnorm(1, 0, 1.1)),
    peat = max(1, peat_base + rnorm(1, 0, 1.1)),
    salt = max(1, salt_base + rnorm(1, 0, 0.7)),
    moor = max(1, moor_base + rnorm(1, 0, 1.1)),
    total_share = inland + peat + salt + moor,
    inland = 100 * inland / total_share,
    peat = 100 * peat / total_share,
    salt = 100 * salt / total_share,
    moor = 100 * moor / total_share
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-ends_with("_base"), -total_share) %>%
  mutate(
    carbon_class = cut(
      carbon_mt,
      breaks = c(-Inf, 50, 100, 250, 500, 1200),
      labels = c("0-50", "50-100", "100-250", "250-500", "500-1,200"),
      right = TRUE
    )
  )

write.csv(country_data, "synthetic_country_wetland_data.csv", row.names = FALSE)
country_data
```

## Map construction

```{r map, fig.width=12.5, fig.height=8.4, out.width='100%'}
crs_europe <- 3035

world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

europe <- world %>%
  filter(continent == "Europe" | iso_a2 %in% c("TR", "CY")) %>%
  left_join(country_data %>% select(iso_a2, carbon_class), by = "iso_a2") %>%
  st_transform(crs_europe)

project_points <- function(data, lon_col, lat_col, x_name, y_name) {
  pts <- st_as_sf(
    data,
    coords = c(lon_col, lat_col),
    crs = 4326,
    remove = FALSE
  ) %>%
    st_transform(crs_europe)
  xy <- st_coordinates(pts)
  data[[x_name]] <- xy[, 1]
  data[[y_name]] <- xy[, 2]
  data
}

plot_data <- country_data %>%
  project_points("lon", "lat", "pie_x", "pie_y") %>%
  project_points("label_lon", "label_lat", "label_x", "label_y")

wetland_colours <- c(
  "Inland marshes" = "#188F13",
  "Peatbogs" = "#7A3E00",
  "Salt marshes" = "#2932B8",
  "Moors and heathland" = "#A4AD00"
)

carbon_colours <- c(
  "0-50" = "#E7F5F7",
  "50-100" = "#A8DADB",
  "100-250" = "#68C2A8",
  "250-500" = "#2CA45F",
  "500-1,200" = "#006D2D"
)

make_pies <- function(data, radius = 88000, points_per_slice = 36) {
  classes <- c("Inland marshes", "Peatbogs", "Salt marshes", "Moors and heathland")
  value_cols <- c("inland", "peat", "salt", "moor")
  pieces <- vector("list", nrow(data) * length(classes))
  k <- 1

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(data))) {
    values <- as.numeric(data[i, value_cols])
    angles <- c(0, cumsum(values / sum(values)) * 2 * pi)

    for (j in seq_along(classes)) {
      theta <- seq(angles[j], angles[j + 1], length.out = points_per_slice)
      pieces[[k]] <- tibble(
        iso_a2 = data$iso_a2[i],
        wetland_class = classes[j],
        piece = paste(data$iso_a2[i], j, sep = "_"),
        x = c(data$pie_x[i], data$pie_x[i] + radius * cos(theta), data$pie_x[i]),
        y = c(data$pie_y[i], data$pie_y[i] + radius * sin(theta), data$pie_y[i])
      )
      k <- k + 1
    }
  }

  bind_rows(pieces)
}

pie_polygons <- make_pies(plot_data)

carbon_legend <- tibble(
  label = names(carbon_colours),
  fill_key = names(carbon_colours),
  xmin = 6020000,
  xmax = 6210000,
  ymin = seq(4920000, 4120000, length.out = 5),
  ymax = ymin + 110000
)

wetland_legend <- tibble(
  label = names(wetland_colours),
  fill_key = names(wetland_colours),
  xmin = 6920000,
  xmax = 6990000,
  ymin = seq(4930000, 4330000, length.out = 4),
  ymax = ymin + 70000
)

fill_values <- c(carbon_colours, wetland_colours)

p <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = europe,
    aes(fill = carbon_class),
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.33,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = plot_data,
    aes(x = pie_x, y = pie_y, xend = label_x, yend = label_y),
    linewidth = 0.42,
    colour = "#565656",
    alpha = 0.80
  ) +
  geom_polygon(
    data = pie_polygons,
    aes(x = x, y = y, group = piece, fill = wetland_class),
    colour = NA
  ) +
  geom_label(
    data = plot_data,
    aes(x = label_x, y = label_y, label = iso_a2),
    size = 3.0,
    label.size = 0,
    label.padding = unit(0.18, "lines"),
    fill = scales::alpha("#BFE3D2", 0.82),
    colour = "#4B4B4B"
  ) +
  geom_rect(
    data = carbon_legend,
    aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = fill_key),
    colour = NA
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = carbon_legend,
    aes(x = xmax + 45000, y = (ymin + ymax) / 2, label = label),
    hjust = 0,
    size = 3.35,
    colour = "#202020"
  ) +
  geom_rect(
    data = wetland_legend,
    aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = fill_key),
    colour = NA
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = wetland_legend,
    aes(x = xmax + 45000, y = (ymin + ymax) / 2, label = label),
    hjust = 0,
    size = 3.15,
    colour = "#202020"
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text", x = 6020000, y = 5650000,
    label = "Total carbon storage in\n(semi)natural open wetlands\n(2018 mean estimate)",
    hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 3.8, lineheight = 0.96,
    colour = "#202020"
  ) +
  annotate("text", x = 6020000, y = 5170000, label = "Mt C", hjust = 0, size = 3.55) +
  annotate(
    "text", x = 6920000, y = 5170000,
    label = "Wetland class (CLC)", hjust = 0, size = 3.55
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = fill_values, na.value = "#F7F7F7", guide = "none") +
  coord_sf(
    crs = st_crs(crs_europe),
    xlim = c(1000000, 7900000),
    ylim = c(1550000, 5800000),
    expand = FALSE,
    datum = NA,
    clip = "on"
  ) +
  theme_void(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    plot.margin = margin(8, 8, 8, 8)
  )

ggsave(
  "europe_wetland_carbon_map.png",
  plot = p,
  width = 12.5,
  height = 8.4,
  dpi = 320,
  bg = "white"
)

p
```
